CERA SANITARYWARE LIMITED      Notes to the Statement of Audited Standalone Financial Results for the Quarter and Year ended 31st March, 2024:      1) These audited standalone financial results of the Company for the quarter and year ended 31st March, 2024 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and then approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 13th May, 2024.
